jobs.title: Managing Director
jobs.description:
AI & Data Consulting | Office Leadership & Growth

Calgary, AB (Hybrid)
Full-time, permanent position
C$175,000–C$200,000 annually
Opportunity to establish and lead a new Calgary office

Raise has partnered with a growing, AI-first data and engineering consulting firm that helps mid-market and enterprise organizations leverage Generative AI, Agentic AI, data analytics, and intelligent automation to solve complex business challenges and drive measurable results.

Combining deep business expertise with modern technology platforms, our client delivers practical, scalable solutions that create meaningful business impact.

Now, they're looking for someone to build and lead their Calgary operation.

This is a unique opportunity for an experienced technology consulting professional who brings together technical expertise, proven people leadership, strategic thinking, and strong client relationships.

We're looking for someone who understands what it takes to build a successful consulting business, from developing a thoughtful market strategy and recruiting the right talent to leading client engagements and establishing a high-performing local team.

This is not a traditional sales or business development role.

Success requires more than an established network or the ability to generate new business. You'll need the technical credibility to engage directly in client solution discussions, the leadership experience to build and manage a team, and the strategic mindset to turn a new market opportunity into a sustainable business.

You'll work directly with the founders and executive leadership, with significant autonomy and accountability for establishing the Calgary office and shaping its long-term success.

Whether you've previously helped build a practice or are ready to take the next step into broader business leadership, this is an opportunity to make a tangible impact.

What You'll Be Doing

Client Relationships & Market Strategy

Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with senior executives and business leaders across Calgary's business community.
Develop a clear, actionable go-to-market strategy that identifies target industries, priority accounts, service opportunities, and measurable growth objectives.
Establish strategic partnerships and build credibility within Calgary's technology and business communities.
Identify opportunities to expand client relationships while maintaining accountability for service quality and successful delivery.

Office Development, Planning & Operations

Collaborate with the founders and executive leadership to align the Calgary operation with the company's broader strategic objectives.
Develop and execute a comprehensive plan to establish, operate, and grow the Calgary office – balancing sales and client relationships, people leadership, project delivery, and business performance
Define the organizational structure, resource and hiring priorities, service development, and operational processes needed to build a successful local consulting practice.
Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of consulting and technical professionals – fostering a team environment that enables exceptional client delivery
Establish clear performance expectations, KPIs, and measurable milestones across client engagement, consulting delivery, team development, and commercial performance to guide the office's development.

Consulting & Technical Leadership

Lead and contribute to client engagements, bringing practical experience in technology consulting, solution development, and project delivery.
Conversant with technical discussions involving AI, data engineering, analytics, cloud technologies and solution architecture.
Translate complex business challenges into practical technology solutions, collaborating with engineering and delivery teams to determine appropriate solutions.
Oversee consulting engagements to ensure projects are delivered effectively, client expectations are met, and business outcomes are achieved.
Serve as a credible bridge between executive stakeholders, technical teams, and consulting delivery resources.

What You'll Bring

7+ years of progressive experience in technology consulting, IT professional services, or a related technical consulting environment.
Proven people leadership experience, with responsibility for managing, developing, and mentoring technical or consulting teams.
Previous hands-on experience in software development, data engineering, solution architecture, or technical implementation.
The ability to independently participate in technical discovery and solution discussions, understand engineering approaches, and collaborate effectively with technical specialists.
Experience developing and executing business plans, go-to-market strategies, or consulting practice growth initiatives.
Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of services-based consulting, including project scoping, resource planning, delivery accountability, and client relationship management.
Experience building relationships with senior executives and translating business needs into actionable consulting opportunities.
Excellent communication, active listening, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to facilitate productive discussions and engage diverse stakeholders.
Strong organizational and decision-making skills, with the ability to establish priorities, develop actionable plans, and hold teams accountable.
An entrepreneurial mindset, sound judgment, and the confidence to lead an operation with significant autonomy.
Experience establishing a new office, launching a consulting practice, or expanding a regional operation is a nice to have.
An established professional network within Calgary or Alberta's business community.
Experience delivering consulting services to Oil & Gas, Energy, Financial Services, or large enterprise clients.
A degree or professional background in computer science, engineering, information technology, data science, or a related discipline.
Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Databricks, Snowflake, or modern AI and data platforms preferred but not required.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

We're looking for a well-rounded consulting leader who can see the big picture while understanding what it takes to execute.

Someone who can build strong relationships with executive stakeholders, confidently participate in technical discussions, and lead a team through the successful delivery of complex consulting engagements.

You'll Be Successful Here If You

Lead by example: You bring meaningful consulting and technical experience, allowing you to guide teams and contribute to client solutions.
Think strategically: You can develop a thoughtful business plan, establish meaningful KPIs, and articulate how you'll build a successful operation.
Build great teams: You have experience identifying talent, developing people, and creating an environment where teams can succeed.
Understand the technology: You don't need to be the most technical person in the room, but you can independently engage in engineering and solution conversations.
Build relationships through trust: You value listening, collaboration, and understanding client needs over transactional selling.
Take ownership: You're comfortable making decisions, solving problems, and being accountable for the success of a growing business.
Balance vision with execution: You can set a strategic direction while remaining actively involved in the work required to achieve it.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

Build a business. Build a team. Make your mark.

This is an opportunity to take on a meaningful leadership role within a growing technology consulting organization, with the freedom to influence how an entirely new office is established and developed.

Rather than inheriting an existing team and predetermined business model, you'll have the opportunity to shape the Calgary operation, from its market strategy and client relationships to its hiring priorities and consulting capabilities.

You'll work directly with the founders and executive leadership, combining the support and expertise of an established organization with the autonomy and ownership of an entrepreneurial venture.

For an experienced consulting professional ready to step into broader leadership, this could be the career-defining opportunity you've been looking for.

And for someone who has already built and led a successful consulting practice, it's an opportunity to bring that experience to a growing organization operating at the forefront of AI and data transformation.

If you're ready to combine your technical consulting expertise, leadership experience, and entrepreneurial ambition to build something meaningful, we'd love to connect.

Looking for Meaningful Work? We can help.

We strive to build teams that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. jobs.description:
Imagine yourself…

Building the technology that becomes the world's most trusted water intelligence platform, turning complex data into critical decisions that protect communities, ecosystems, and public health.
Leading high-performing engineering teams at a market-leading SaaS company with a global customer base, strong recurring revenue, and a bold vision for AI-enabled innovation.
Leaving a legacy beyond software by creating solutions that help safeguard one of the world's most essential resources: WATER.

It’s possible with a role at Aquatic Informatics (https://aquaticinformatics.com/).

Aquatic Informatics (AQI), a Veralto company, is a mission-driven software company
that organizes the world’s water data to make it accessible and useful. We provide software solutions that address critical water data management, analytics, and compliance challenges for the rapidly growing water industry. We offer a full range of solutions, from standalone software packages for individual users, hosted software services, and enterprise-wide national systems. We serve over 1,000 municipal, federal, state/provincial, hydropower, mining, academic, and consulting organizations in over 60 countries that collect, manage, and process large volumes of water data.

Aquatic Informatics is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada and has offices in the US and Australia. We value independent thinking, initiative, teamwork, a relentless pursuit of quality, a playful spirit, and a sense of humor. We like smart people – IQ and EQ – who care about the environment and want to do good in the world. Ours is a unique culture where purpose meets possibility: where the work we do makes a real difference on the world’s valuable water resources, and where you’ll have opportunities to own your ambition and fuel your career growth.

We offer:

Flexible working hours
Professional onboarding and training options
Powerful team looking forward to working with you
Career coaching and development opportunities
Health benefits

Reporting to the Vice President & General Manager, the VP of Software Engineering
will lead AQI’s software engineering organization and define the architectural and platform strategy that enables Product’s roadmap
. Define and execute AQI’s architecture and platform strategy in close partnership with Product Management, translating product direction into the technical “how” that enables faster, scalable delivery.
Lead a distributed engineering organization of approximately 60–80 associates, including a senior L2 leadership team across Canada, the U.S. and India.
Modernize legacy code, platforms, and products while supporting cloud, hybrid cloud, and on-prem solutions across Azure and AWS environments.
Accelerate software delivery and product releases while maintaining quality, security, reliability, and customer impact.
Establish engineering excellence through modern Agile, DevOps, architectural governance, prioritization, trade-off decision-making, and execution rigor.
Leverage AI for coding and development acceleration, with the opportunity to support AI-enabled product capabilities that customers can use.
Coach, mentor, and inspire engineering leaders while fostering collaboration, accountability, followership, and a team-first culture that fits AQI’s mission-driven environment.

What You Bring

15+ years of software engineering experience, ideally with at least 7 years in engineering leadership roles.
Proven ability to lead software organizations through scale, modernization, platform evolution, and improved speed of delivery.
Experience leading leaders in multi-layer engineering organizations, including coaching autonomous senior managers without becoming a gatekeeper or micromanager.
Strong technical depth across software architecture, cloud-native and on-prem platforms, Azure and AWS, APIs, DevOps practices, and scalable enterprise software systems.
Track record of measurable impact, such as accelerating development, improving product release velocity, modernizing platforms, increasing quality, reducing complexity, or enabling customer and business outcomes.
Mission-driven mindset and genuine interest in AQI’s purpose: using water data, analytics, and technology to support water conservation, chemical savings, energy savings, environmental impact, and smarter water management.

jobs.title: Sales Leader, Enterprise - Americas
jobs.description:
Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love during an AI-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Bolt, and Notion, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year-over-year. We’re well funded, and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks.

We have, in just a few years, replaced incumbents Greenhouse and Lever more than 500 times each, clear evidence of strong product-market fit and a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software. Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader in the recruiting space.

And the market opportunity is growing. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote-first, high-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise & Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!

You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say about working here.

About This Role

TA tools in the Enterprise represent a huge market opportunity, a $1B+ TAM, and the incumbents are legacy players. We are displacing a collection of tools (ATS, Sourcing & CRM, Scheduling, Analytics, Offers & Approvals) with a consolidated talent suite. This is a proven playbook that Workday used to win the HCM market as customers realize value in a multitude of ways, and we are on track to do the same.

Responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Sales Leader in North America to lead the segment and scale our Enterprise AE team - West (Mountain, Pacific, Central). There are three primary responsibilities that this sales leader will take on:

Own the revenue outcomes for the segment, with clear accountability for delivering results. Partner with the senior AEs in a team selling motion to maximize our win rates on the company's largest opportunities. Manage deal risks and help navigate the complexities of large-scale competitive replacement deals.
Build a high caliber team in lock step with market demand. In general we believe that smaller, high caliber teams can achieve remarkable results. Your Enterprise team will be an adept group of solution selling experts.
Establish a reputation for excellence by fostering alignment across Product, Marketing, Solutions Engineering & Professional Services creating a flywheel for future enterprise customer acquisition.

In this role, you’ll report to our Head of AMER Sales (Leigh Brown) and have significant impact in defining our go-to-market strategy and sales methodology. If we are even moderately successful relative to our ambition, we'll have an incredible growth story to tell in just a few years!

You Could Be a Great Fit If

💼 You’ve led and scaled a team of SaaS Enterprise Account Executives delivering $5M/yr+ at a company that has scaled beyond $100M ARR
💰 You have helped win $1M+ SaaS deals with publicly traded companies, and can help your team see around corners on complex deals
🥇 You have a proven track record of hiring and onboarding Ent AEs who can create their own pipeline and close both more tactical ($100k) and strategic ($500k+) deals
📊 You have a strong mental model for enterprise sales execution. At the same time, you're a lifelong learner and are open to new ideas and experimentation.
🤝 You build trusted relationships with customers and confidently facilitate peer-to-peer conversations between senior leaders to deepen partnerships and elevate strategic engagements.
🤓 You become a product and industry expert. You connect the dots quickly. Customers and your team trust you to provide practical advice and relevant stories.
⚙️ You have successfully sold a complex multi-product platform and have won competitive rip-and-replace sales motions.

Bonus

You have sold to Talent and/or People leaders and are familiar with their pains and priorities

You Shouldn't Apply If

You're a dashboard-and-forecast manager who doesn't like to get into the deals and daily operations
You're not keen on learning our substantial product. "That's for SEs" isn't how we approach things here.

Our Philosophy

Here Are a Few Key Points That Should Give You An Idea Of What It Is Like To Work With Us

We have clear expectations about what it means to be a leader at Ashby
We're highly collaborative and we believe in a team-based sales motion to maximize our win rates on high impact deals
We believe in developing subject matter expertise (not just on our product but also the TA space broadly) which allows us to provide a differentiated buyer experience
We continue to make material investments in engineering and product because we know at the end of the day, having the best product makes winning new customers easier

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over decades of experience, and thoughtful & clear communication both internally and with customers.

Interview Process

Our interview process is designed so you can showcase your achievements and points of learning and apply those to a practical exercise. We'll provide you with sample customer calls and pipeline data so you can develop a well informed perspective on our product and the Enterprise segment. You’ll have opportunities to ask questions of our team throughout.

The interview process for this role is four rounds in the following order:

Intro Call (30 min) - You'll meet with Recruiting to discuss your fit for the role and address questions about our market and solution.
Experience Deep Dive (1 hr) - You'll walk Leigh through your career journey in some detail to highlight your experience, achievements, and points of learning to understand how you've developed into the leader you are today.
Panel Presentation (1 hr) - We'll provide you with pipeline data and seek your perspective on the segment. You'll discuss your approach to hiring, coaching and sales execution.
Final Round (2.5 hrs) - You'll have a set of four interviews with cross-functional leaders

Benefits

A product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about
Competitive salary, commission and equity.
10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year.
Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
$100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Real World Data Science
jobs.description:
At AstraZeneca, we pride ourselves on crafting a collaborative culture that champions knowledge-sharing, ambitious thinking and innovation – ultimately providing employees with the opportunity to work across teams, functions and even the globe.

Recognizing the importance of individualized flexibility, our ways of working allow employees to balance personal and work commitments while ensuring we continue to build a strong culture of collaboration and teamwork by engaging face-to-face in our offices 3 days a week.

Our dedication to sustainability is also central to our culture and part of what makes AstraZeneca a great place to work. We know the health of people, the planet and our business are interconnected which is why we’re taking ambitious action to address some of the biggest challenges of our time, from climate change to access to healthcare and disease prevention.Reporting to the Senior Director, RWD Science, the role will collaborate with epidemiology, statistics, health economics, pharmacovigilance, and medical evidence teams to design and deliver observational studies and advanced analyses that support therapeutic-area strategies, product development, and business decision-making. The role has a global remit and is based within AstraZeneca’s global geographical footprint.

Key Responsibilities

RWD analysis and delivery: Deliver and implement secondary data analyses using electronic health records, insurance claims, registries, and other observational data to address therapeutic-area evidence needs
Scientific and technical leadership: Provide expert guidance on observational study design, data-source selection, data-partner evaluation, statistical analysis plans, and best practices in RWD utilization.
Assess the strengths, limitations, capabilities, and suitability of external RWD sources
Cross-functional collaboration: Work with epidemiologists, statisticians, health economists, medical teams, and other stakeholders throughout the study execution.
Mentor and coach data scientists and contribute to technical education, knowledge sharing, communities of practice, and continuous improvement across the RWDS organization.
Maintain awareness of developments in RWD, causal inference, healthcare analytics, data standards, AI, and emerging analytical platforms, and assess their practical relevance to AZ evidence generation through external partnerships.
Translate complex analytical findings, data limitations, and methodological trade-offs into clear insights and options for scientific and business partners.
Lead or contribute to structured data feasibility and fit-for-purpose assessments that make data availability, quality, completeness, follow-up, endpoint capture, confounding, and key trade-offs visible to study teams.
Apply and advance appropriate statistical, epidemiological, machine-learning, and data-science methods for healthcare research, with methods selected according to the scientific question and data context.
Develop, use, review, and promote standardized and reusable analytical assets, including code, code lists, functions, templates, documentation, and quality-control approaches, to improve consistency and reproducibility.
Use artificial intelligence and automation as decision-support and productivity capabilities with appropriate human oversight, validation, documentation, and protection of patient-level data.

Essential Qualifications And Experience

Advanced degree: PhD or MSc in statistics, mathematics, data science, or a life-sciences discipline, combined with relevant industry experience.
RWE expertise: Proven experience delivering real-world evidence or observational research, with familiarity in epidemiology, health economics, health-outcomes modelling, or related quantitative disciplines.
Healthcare data: Hands-on experience working with EMR/EHR, disease-registry, and/or insurance-claims databases.

We have clear expectations about what it means to be a leader at Ashby
We're highly collaborative and we believe in a team-based sales motion to maximize our win rates on high impact deals
